mapper.insert: insert into goods (name, description, price, stock, img, category_id, sales, store, brand, content, spec_list) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{img}, #{categoryId}, 0, #{store}, #{brand}, #{content}, #{specList})
mapper.update: update goods set sales = sales + #{num} where id = #{id}
update goods set stock = stock - #{num} where id = #{id} and stock >= #{num}
update goods set stock = #{total} where id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from goods where stock < #{threshold}
